decision.next_empirical_scope: At most one separately authorized protocol smoke request before any new five-match difficulty experiment.

l2_to_l3_inversion.claim_boundary: Four matches leave one anchor family missing in every level, so the L2-L3 contrast is composition-confounded. These are candidate mechanisms only. No field, scenario or level may be rewritten until a protocol-complete registered run replicates the direction.

matched_control_coverage.interpretation: A raw level difference from this four-match subset mixes difficulty with the one missing anchor family in each level.

primary_interpretation.interpretation: The frozen primary remains the official estimand, but its gap over informative and value-balanced companions shows that constant and majority-value cells materially inflate apparent local extraction. This is not evidence for global text hardening.
